products.description:
ODOUR REMOVER 
 Freshen Up is a new and cleaner type of odour remover with probiotics, developed to reduce unpleasant odours in your fabric furniture and other textiles.
 Freshen Up is for those who expect a little extra from their odour remover products. The product is ECOCERT certified. The bottle and label are made from 100% recycled plastic.
 The product is 100 ml and is enough for several treatments of your furniture. 
 HOW TO USE 
 With the practical bottle, you can give your fabric furniture a fresh boost after thorough vacuuming and cleaning.
 Spray the product directly onto the furniture and let it dry before sitting down and using the furniture. After 20 minutes, the good bacteria will already make a difference, so you will notice less odour. After 24 hours, you will have the full effect, which can last for up to eight days.
 CONTENTS 
 Water, alcohols, zinc ricinoleate, sequestrants, solvents, denaturant, zinc lactate, maltodextrin, microorganisms. 99.6% of the ingredients are of natural origin. Natural Detergent certified by ECOCERT Greenlife in accordance with the ECOCERT standard available at http://detergents.ecocert.com/en .
 Read more about probiotics and the products at Byoms HERE .

products.subtitle: Dish soap
products.description:
STAIN REMOVER AND CLEANSING SOAP 
 Probiotic Dish Soap is a mild and gentle soap that is both effective and kind when you need to clean or remove stains from your sofa or other fabric furniture.
 The product is ECOCERT certified and free from perfume, chlorine, dyes and synthetic materials, which makes it exceptionally gentle on both the furniture and your hands.
 HOW TO USE FOR STAIN REMOVAL 
 For thin liquids such as coffee, tea, red wine and the like, you should use clean, lint-free cloths that do not transfer colour, lukewarm water or sparkling water, along with Dish Soap with probiotics. Avoid using other stain removers unless you have professional assistance. 
 Try to treat a stain immediately. We recommend acting quickly, as this gives the best result. If the stain has dried in, start by vacuuming the entire surface very thoroughly. To avoid watermarks, the whole seating surface can be treated, and you should set aside plenty of time.
 Dab up the liquid with a dry, lint-free cloth
 Dab the stain and the rest of the surface with sparkling water to avoid lime marks from the water
 Use a drop of Dish Soap or soap foam made from the soap mixed with sparkling water

products.description:
EIK base – wall-mounted desk and multifunctional station in solid oak 
 EIK base is a wall-mounted desk in solid oak with beautiful craftsmanship details, designed for modern homes where function, flexibility and aesthetics go hand in hand.  Wall-mounted desk for the home office
 Coffee station in the kitchen 
 Vanity table in the bedroom 
 Bar station in the living room 
 Wall-mounted table for the children’s room – perfect as a small desk, drawing table or vanity table
 One base – multiple function 
 EIK base is designed to serve multiple purposes.

products.title: BRONTON - Relief Nr. AB1
products.subtitle: Relief Nr. AB1
products.description:
RELIEF 
 By Anne Bronton 
 The beautifully designed wall reliefs combine traditional cord weaving with environmentally conscious material choices to create a unique and decorative element for your home. Each relief is handcrafted and presents a delicate pattern woven from FSC-certified paper cord, highlighting both the craftsmanship behind it and the dedication to sustainability. The frames are made from solid oak sourced from FSC-certified forests, ensuring responsible forest management. 
 The natural color of the cord and the oak frame fits perfectly into the Nordic interior style, where they can be combined with most furniture to create a harmonious and balanced space. 
 UNIQUE WORKS 
 The craftsmanship gives the reliefs a distinctive character. Variations in the weaving and the natural color variations of the paper cord contribute to the individual character of each relief. This means that the relief you receive may have minor differences in appearance compared to the images shown, making it completely unique. 
 VARIANTS 
 Choose between three sizes and many different patterns. 
 If you are interested in a unique piece in other sizes, you are welcome to contact us HERE .
 APPLICATION 
 The reliefs give you the opportunity to create a new expression in your home, as they can easily become a statement piece in any room. Hang a single relief on the wall to create a focal point

products.title: BASECAMP XL Deep Chaiselounge - Left, 9E module, 110x160 cm
products.subtitle: Left, 9E module, 110x160 cm
products.description:
BASECAMP modular sofa
 One sofa – endless possibilities
 BASECAMP is our take on the ultimate modular sofa. A sofa created for long evenings, cosy weekends, and a home that evolves along with you. Here, comfort, flexibility and aesthetics come together in one thoughtfully designed sofa system, where you decide the look – and where memories are made to last a little longer.
 BASECAMP is not just one sofa, but an entire universe of modules that can be combined in countless ways. Whether you dream of a compact sofa, a spacious lounge sofa or an extra-deep solution for maximum relaxation, BASECAMP can be tailored to your home and your needs.
 One modular concept – three versions
 BASECAMP is available in three variants, all of which can be freely combined:
 BASECAMP – the classic module size
 BASECAMP XL – modules that are longer than BASECAMP
 BASECAMP XL DEEP – modules that are both longer and deeper than BASECAMP
 With a total of 26 different modules, BASECAMP gives you even more possibilities to create the sofa that perfectly suits your way of living. You can mix sizes, change the configuration over time and add new modules as your needs change. All modules are fully upholstered all the way around and can therefore be used both on their own and together with other modules.
 Documented strength and durability
 The BASECAMP modular sofa is tested according to the demanding Europe

PRIMETIME armchair 
 The armchair for the best time of day
 The PRIMETIME armchair was born after the internationally recognized architect Tom Stepp became the father of a little girl. He needed a chair big enough for 2 – a comfortable chair where he could sit with his little girl and enjoy a cozy moment at the end of the day. That's why he designed PRIMETIME.
Here you get the furniture where you can find space for contemplation and presence with your children or disappear into the world of books. Then life doesn't get any better! The PRIMETIME chair is also very popular with children, as it can rotate.
MAKE nordic has taken over this Danish classic, which was previously sold by Fredericia Furniture. The PRIMETIME armchair has been optimized so that the timeless expression of the past meets the comfort and quality of the future.
 Design your own

The soft cushions with cold foam and down top can be covered with several different fabric variants or leather.

 The PRIMETIME armchair was born after the internationally recognized architect Tom Stepp became the father of a little girl. GOLIAT stool 
 Unique chair from 1953 by Poul M. Volther 
 In the GOLIAT chair you get the sculptural weight that characterizes the Danish designer Poul M. Volther. He designed the chair for the Copenhagen Furniture Carpentry Exhibition in 1953, where the chair won a prize. The chair was then produced by master joiner Erhard Rasmussen, and it was never put into series production. It is therefore at MAKE nordic that the GOLIAT chair sees the light of day for the first time in 2017.  When Poul M. Volther had won the prize at the Carpenters' Autumn Exhibition, the chair was sent to Sweden, where it was forgotten for many years. Jakob Volther received a newsletter from an auction house in Sweden where his father's beautiful chair was for sale. One of the few examples that had been produced in the 1950s. Jakob Volther immediately saw the potential in the iconic armchair, which today is an important part of the furniture collection at MAKE nordic. After just a few years, the GOLIAT armchair has found a place in many homes - and in many hearts.

round-dining-tables.title: Round dining tables
round-dining-tables.description:

A round dining table is a genuine conversation table where everyone at the table can look each other in the eye. Then a round table might be just right for your family.

small-tables.title: Small tables
small-tables.description:
Small tables are practical and beautiful pieces of furniture that fit into any home. With small tables in your home, you can store various things, eat delicious food, play board games and enjoy pleasant evenings and days. Not least, small tables give your home a nice and well-thought-out look. See our selection of beautiful, small tables on this page.
 Furnish your home cozy with small tables

sofas.title: Sofas
sofas.description:
Danish design sofas

The architect-designed sofas are handmade in collaboration with Danish and European cabinetmakers and furniture posters who are used to making beautiful design sofas.
